description: The creation of a new vehicle access and alterations to the existing car parking provisions of Unit 24. The creation of a new vehicle access and gate to the yard of Unit PM/004 and reconfiguration of the existing service yard. Installation of a new shutter door to Unit PM/005 and new car parking spaces and yard access gate.
